subject.title: [Feature] Prune stale orphaned sessions from Dashboard Sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a cross-channel Dashboard prune flow for orphaned Telegram/Discord sessions, and what reachability, retention, default-age, and auto-prune policy should it use?
rationale: The remaining work deletes persistent session state across plugin-owned channel reachability, user history retention, and possible new configuration surface; source inspection does not support a narrow automated bug-fix choice.

options.title: Preview-first Dashboard prune
options.body: Add a Dashboard candidate preview backed by plugin-owned reachability checks, then revalidate and delete only after explicit user confirmation.

options.title: Narrow Discord-first cleanup
options.body: Resolve the narrower Discord orphan-session path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50310 first and defer cross-channel Dashboard UX.

options.title: Keep manual cleanup only
options.body: Keep selected-row deletion and CLI cleanup as the supported paths and decline automatic orphan pruning in core for now.

recommendation.title: Preview-first Dashboard prune
recommendation.body: Add a Dashboard candidate preview backed by plugin-owned reachability checks, then revalidate and delete only after explicit user confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Control UI sessions and session maintenance policy.
